verdict.rationale: Make documents an official TypeScript SDK on its Developer Hub client-libraries page, with type definitions, built-in error handling and response typing, so developers can build against it directly. Missing for 10: SDKs in languages other than TypeScript, coverage of all API endpoints (only 'a majority' is claimed), and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Make Typescript SDK provides full support for type definitions and a majority of Make API endpoints, built-in error handling, and response typing.
